name: Milky [Beta]
desc:
Welcome to Milky — where numbers go up, your sanity goes down, and a tree is more than just branches. It's a lifestyle.

In this game, you’ll:
🧱 Build the ultimate upgrade tree, and lactose tolerance
⏫ Watch your stats skyrocket with absurdly broken mechanics
💥 Reset, prestige, ascend, and question reality
🐄 Possibly milk a cow. Spiritually.

Whether you're into watching numbers rise, endlessly upgrading, or just really like incrementals, this game’s for you.

🎉 Stop reading. Play it. Your unlimited empire awaits. 🎉

🌟 Premium Perk: +20% Stats (yes, really)
📢 v0.1.2 - Still early! Join our community to see what's next. (13+)

⚠️ No exploits — we see all 🧀
(Macros that repeat through that one sequence? Yeah, we cool with that.)
